types.name: Incident
types.description: A service disruption or operational event with defined timeline, impact, and resolution

types.name: Runbook
types.description: A documented procedure for diagnosing and resolving operational issues

types.name: PipelineStage
types.description: A distinct processing phase in a multi-stage data or inference pipeline

types.name: EvaluationSet
types.description: A curated collection of test questions with reference answers used to benchmark system performance

types.name: PermissionGroup
types.description: A security group or role that controls access to content and knowledge graph facts

types.name: DataRetentionPolicy
types.description: A defined rule for how long data is kept and when it is deleted

relationships.description: An incident results in the creation of a Jira ticket for tracking
A runbook documents procedures that fix or mitigate a type of incident
A runbook specifies which team to escalate issues to
A pipeline stage generates or outputs a component or artifact
One pipeline stage comes before another in sequence
A metric threshold determines whether a service version can be released
A service is benchmarked against a fixed evaluation set
A component transforms or rewrites a query into another form
A service provides streaming responses through a specific endpoint protocol
A service restricts results based on user's permission groups
A component or fact is derived from source content
A service removes or obscures personally identifiable information before storage
A retention policy governs data lifecycle in a specific store
Runtime call or dependency from component/service to API endpoint or data store (database calls, not covered by STORES_IN)
A metric evaluates or measures the target (HTTP status codes, storage metrics, performance, etc.)
